headline: Parul Pruthi is the new global R&D head HR, Lumax Industries Engineering Centre
summary: Parul Pruthi has been appointed as the new Global R&D Head HR at Lumax Industries Engineering Centre. She joins from Revolt Motors, where she served as CHRO, and brings extensive experience in talent management and HR leadership within the automotive and R&D sectors. In her new role, Pruthi will focus on driving HR strategy, employee engagement, and talent pipelines to support Lumax's innovation and business growth.

headline: Kroger cuts 3,000 corporate jobs as AI reshapes work
summary: Kroger plans to reduce its corporate workforce by 3,000 positions over the next three years as it accelerates AI adoption to streamline administrative operations. Following the block of its proposed merger with Albertsons, the grocery giant is leveraging technology to stay competitive against rivals like Walmart and Amazon. The restructuring targets white-collar roles rather than store personnel, highlighting how automation is increasingly reshaping corporate organization and workforce planning.

headline: Is India’s demand for FDEs and data centre talent growing?
summary: India's expanding AI boom is driving significant growth in demand for specialized technical roles, particularly Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) and data centre specialists. FDE positions combine deep technical skills with client engagement to bridge technology and business outcomes, while data centre hiring has nearly doubled to support growing infrastructure needs. As a result, HR leaders must adapt workforce planning strategies to accommodate these multidisciplinary talent pools and evolving career paths.

headline: Siddharth Junjurde to play regional HR head for Zomato
summary: Zomato has appointed Siddharth Junjurde as its new Regional Head of Human Resources to lead talent optimization and organizational growth. Junjurde, a mechanical engineering graduate, brings HR leadership experience from prominent companies including Amazon, Delhivery, and Curefit. His appointment reflects Zomato's strategic focus on building an inclusive culture and optimizing workforce management in the competitive food tech sector.

headline: SpiceJet pilots halt flights over salary delays
summary: Around 40 SpiceJet Q400 pilots have refused to operate flights until their pending salaries and benefits are paid, exacerbating the cash-strapped carrier's operational disruptions. Backed by the Airline Pilots’ Association of India, the strike comes as the airline operates just 10 aircraft amid strict regulatory monitoring. The crisis underscores the direct risk that unresolved compensation issues and low workforce morale pose to aviation safety and service continuity.

headline: Telangana rewards Singareni workforce with festival bonus
summary: Following a profit of Rs 1,754 crore, the Telangana government announced substantial festival bonuses and expanded welfare measures for employees of Singareni Collieries Company Limited. Alongside direct financial payouts for permanent and contract workers, the state is introducing comprehensive benefits including enhanced accident insurance, housing site allocations, and expedited compassionate appointments. These initiatives highlight a strategic alignment between state policy, corporate performance, and holistic workforce management.

headline: Kissht launches mental wellness programme for employees
summary: Digital lending platform Kissht has launched "Kissht Mitra," a confidential mental wellness program developed in partnership with Yin Yang Leadership Solutions. The initiative offers employees access to professional psychologists and coaches to help them manage personal and workplace pressures. By providing confidential support, Kissht aims to reduce mental health stigma and promote a healthier work-life balance.

headline: AGI Greenpac ropes in Shaili Tyagi as CHRO
summary: AGI Greenpac has appointed Shaili Tyagi as its Chief Human Resources Officer, effective October 12, 2026. Tyagi brings over 25 years of experience in human resources, specialization in talent management, organizational design, and corporate transformation. Prior to joining AGI Greenpac, she held senior executive HR roles at several prominent companies, including Sheela Foam, DCM Shriram, and Bharti Airtel.

headline: Yuken India appoints Ganesh S S as head–HR
summary: Yuken India has appointed Ganesh S S as its new Head of Human Resources, effective October 10, 2026. Ganesh brings over 15 years of HR experience across the IT, manufacturing, and construction sectors, having previously held senior roles at Infiniminds, MAC Machine Tools, and U E Development India. Holding an MBA in HR and an LLB, he brings extensive expertise in workforce management, employee relations, and labor law compliance to his new position.

headline: blackNgreen plans up to 100% expansion of technology team as AI reshapes operations
summary: Telecom technology company blackNgreen plans to expand its technology workforce by up to 100 percent over the next 12 months to support global growth and deeper AI integration. The hiring push follows substantial efficiency gains from company-wide AI adoption, which has significantly shortened product development cycles and reduced operational hours. To align with this expansion, the firm is also revamping its compensation model to include growth-linked profit sharing across all employee levels.

headline: Hyundai celebrates 30 years in India with new film
summary: Hyundai Motor India has released a new corporate film to mark 30 years of operations in the country, highlighting its growth alongside India's economic development. The film traces the brand's evolution from basic transportation to an enabler of personal growth while outlining its vision for future mobility. Moving forward, the automaker plans to focus on smart technology, sustainability, and human-centric mobility solutions.
